identitySemanticsByLanguage.en: One Grok Bot character with one continuous smooth soft geometric body and paired capsule eyes. No arms, hands, legs, feet, mouth, fur, robotic mechanism or screen face.
identitySemanticsByLanguage.zh-CN: 单个 Grok Bot 角色，连续光滑软几何身体与成对胶囊眼。无手臂、手、腿、脚、嘴、绒毛、机械构造或屏幕脸。

semanticByLanguage.en: a taller narrower rounded rectangular block

semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 浅蓝色光滑软硅胶材质
成对竖向象牙白胶囊眼

semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 成对短竖胶囊眼，静态放松表情

semanticByLanguage.en: a fitted navy rib-knit lower-body wrap with ivory piping
